When the weather turns sunny.

When the weather condition is no longer sunny.

Removes the frozen condition from the user. Lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def by [Digit:1digit ] stat [EN:Qty S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Leaves the target burned.

moves.name:
Heart of
Shining Gold!
moves.description: Applies the Gradual Healing effect to all allied sync pairs. Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="7" ] [EN:Qty Ref="7" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Applies [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="9" ] to the allied field of play. [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="9" ] grants all of the following effects: Powers up the moves and sync moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit ]%. Reduces attack move and sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%. The more sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] that are on the allied field of play, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ]% and reduces damage by [Digit:1digit Idx="4" ]%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="5" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="6" ]%.)

passives.name: Shimmering Rainbow Flames
passives.description: The user’s moves never miss. When a move used by the user’s Pokémon that targets itself or an ally is successful, the target becomes all allied sync pairs. When a move used by the user’s Pokémon that targets an opponent is successful, the target becomes all opposing sync pairs. When the user’s sync move attacks an opponent, the target becomes all opposing sync pairs. The power and chance of applying additional effects of moves and sync moves affected by this passive skill are not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with the user’s following attacks become critical hits: Pokémon’s moves or sync move.
